name: @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin
description: DSH: Windows2MacOS — drive the same project on online Windows and macOS machines from one DeepSeek account, across networks and regions. P2P hole punching is the default path (relay + shared server as rendezvous, ledger and fallback), with a bundled STUN responder, Tailscale/public-VPS/tunnel shapes, Rabbit relay + per-machine Localside + eight DSH tools (replicate / split), nine aggregate verdicts and signed requests.

permissions.network: the configured relay (default: the shared server above), STUN servers, and UDP to the peer machines
permissions.filesystem: read/write inside the project directory and DSH_HOME; the agent writes its spool and state under --state
